BENEXT.JSON(5) FreeBSD File Formats Manual BENEXT.JSON(5)

NAME

benext.json — benext configuration file

DESCRIPTION

Strict JSON (RFC 8259) object. Unknown keys are errors.

checks_dir
Absolute path of the health-check directory. Default /etc/benext.d.
keep
Integer 0–50: fallback boot environments kept by prune. Default 3.
reboot_cmd
Command run when a boot is unhealthy. Default “shutdown -r now”.

FILES

/etc/benext/config.json

SEE ALSO

benext(8)
